title: RTEC Kentucky EEO certification history
certification_authority: Commonwealth of Kentucky Finance and Administration Cabinet, Office of EEO and Contract Compliance
gaps: No certification approval letter for the period ending 2024-09-30 was located in the approval-letter folder during this pass.
No certification approval letter for the period ending 2025-09-30 was located in the approval-letter folder during this pass.
Signed annual renewal forms exist through 2023 and may document submissions even where the approval letter is absent.
source_interpretation: Each observed approval letter states RTEC was certified to do business with the Commonwealth under Kentucky's Equal Employment Opportunity Act, KRS 45.550-45.640.
The approval letters describe one-year certification periods and state that a recertification notice will be sent before expiration.
Certification approval is distinct from FTA/KYTC approval of an EEO/Affirmative Action Plan; both histories should be retained separately.
currentness: The latest approval source found is dated 2025-09-24 and states expiration 2026-09-30. This does not prove renewal after that date.
privacy: Organization-level certification evidence only; signed renewal forms may contain individual signatory details but not employee-case records.
